This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s caSCI 
payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions to the 
primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer (NBBO). BSC 
receives no cash payment or other consideration for such order routing other 
than favorable executions or executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

Ea? NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO TRUTH IN LENDING SEC RULE 10b46 
The annual rate of interest charged on any credit extended to you by Bear. 
Steams Securities Corp. CBSSC) for the purpose of purchasing, carrying or 
trading in any sectrity or other property shall continuo to be based on either 
the BSSC Margin Basis Rate. the BSSC Fed Funds Rate a the London 
Interbank Offered Rate (-LIBOR". as notified to you upon request. The BSSC 
Margin Basis Rate will be quoted each business day by BSSC at as main 
office in New Yak. Factors affecting the determination of the BSSC Margin 
Basis Rate will include the short-term market interest rates quoted by money 
center banks and the Federal Reserve and the rate that BSSC is charged for 
borrowing money. 
The purpose of this notice is to advise you that effective no earlier than thirty 
(30) days from your receipt of this statement: 
If BSSC makes changes in any of the credit terms and conditions described 
herein or If a change is required by law. we wit notify you of such change within 
a reasonable period of time, unless such change results in the same a a 
higher rate to you, in which case we cad provide you at least 30 days' prior 
written notice. The annual rate of interest you are charged may fluctuate with 
changes In the BSSC Margin Basis Rate, the BSSC Fed Funds Rate. LIBOR. 
any of the rates quoted by Reuters or the rate provided by BSSC's local bank. 
The changes in rates resulting from this fluctuation will be made without prior 
notice to you (as contrasted with changes In the credit terms and conditions. 
notice of which will be provided as descried above). 
The Truth-in-Lencing disclosure previously provided to you shall continue to 
apply except as specifically noted above.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Stearns Securities Corp. flitSSC). a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation rsipm. provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customers funds and securities positions. SIPC provides $500,000 of 
primary net equity protection. including 5100.000 for claims for cash (-SIPC 
Coverage). Visit mwr.sipc.org for mere information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection (*Excess SIP(*) through a commercial 
insurer. Effective February 16. 2004. the convnercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer AsSet Protection Company (CAPCO), a licensed New 
York insurance company. Account protection applies when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to Its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC ineligible assets such as options, futures, 
foreign exchange transactions. or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities.

broker and has to provide its lender additional collateral of up to 105% of the

means that the debit balance on which interest is computed will be the 
difference between (0 up to 105% of the settled short market value of such 
short sales (across all curencies). which shall be calculated daily, and (II) the 
proceeds of such short sales.

Pursuant to the "Truth-in-Lending- Rule 10 (6)413 Regarding Short Sales 
And Marking-To-The-Market 
Effective no earlier than thirty (30) days hem your receipt of this statement. we 
will compute interest regarding you short sales and marking-to-the market as 
follows: 
The credit that appears on you' statement due to short sales (Including short 
sales against the box) is offset by a debit of like amount because Bear Steams 
Securities has to borrow the same smut In MCI TO deliver It to the buying 
broker and has to provide its lender additional collateral of up to 105% of the 
seined Shaft market value of the borrowed securities to secure such loan. This 
means that the debit balance on which interest is computed *4 be the 
difference between (I) up to 105% of the settled short market value of such 
short sales (across all currencies). which shall be calculated daily. and (ii) the 
proceeds of such short sales.

Atilt be quoted daily by Bear Steams at our main office in New York. Factors 
affecting the determination of the Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate will include 
the short-tem, market interest rates quoted by money center banks and the 
Federal Reserve and the rate that Bear Stearns is charged for borrowing 
money. The Bear Steams Fed Funds Rate is die rate for U.S. dollar funds. as 
quoted by an independent broker of such funds selected by Bear Steams for 
the last transaction completed prior to 9:30 a.m, (Eastern Time) on the 
business day on which such rate is determined. The annual rate of interest will 
be no more than 3% above the Bear Steams Margin Basis Rate or 4% above 
either the Bear Stearns fed Finds Rate or LIBOR and will appear on your 
monthly statements.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear, Stearns Securities Corp. (BSSC1. a Member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation (SIPC). provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customer's funds and securities positions. SIPC provides SS00.000 of 
primary net equity protection. including 5100.000 for claims for cash ('SIPC 
Coverage,. Visit viwriSipC.Org fa more information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection (Excess 5IPC') through a commercial 
insurer. Effective February 16. 2004. the commercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer Asset Protection Company MAPCO), a licensed New 
York insurance company. Account protection appkes when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC ineligible assets such as options, futures. 
foreign exchange transactions, or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities. 
End of Statement

Notice Regarding a Change in The Statement of Interest Charges 
Pursuant to the -Truth4n.Lending" Rule 10 (b)-18 Regarding Short Sales 
And Marking-To-The-Market 
Effective no earlier than thirty (30) days from your receipt of this statement we 
VG0 compute interest regarding your short sales and marking-to-the market as 
follows: 
The credit that appears on your statement due to short sales (including short 
sales against the box) is offset by a debit of like amount because Bear Steams 
Securities has to borrow the same security in cider to deliver it to the buying 
broker and has to provide its lender additional collateral of up to 105% of the 
settled short market value of the borrowed securities to secure such loan. This 
means that the debit balance on which interest is computed will be the 
difference between (i) up to 105% of the settled short market value of such 
short sales (across all currencies), which shall be calculated daily, and (ii) the 
proceeds of such short sales. 
End of Statement

Any short positions in your account will be kept 'marked-to-the marker. This 
means that periodicaRy the balance maintained in the short account will be 
adjusted to equal the market value of the sheet securities. Securities that are 
priced below five dollars per share may be valued at five dollars per share for 
short marking-to-the market purposes. If a security has been sold short (or 
sold short against the box) and has appreciated in market price over the 
selling price, interest will be charged on the amount of appreciation: if it 
depredates in market price, interest will be correspondingly reduced by the 
drop in value. The appreciation or depreciation of securities sold short will be 
determined by Bear Steams Securities based upon daily closing prices or 
quotations provided by pricing services, as applicable. or upon such factors as 
Bear Steams Securities in its sole judgement deems pertinent. 
Please note that the other sections of the "Truth-in-lending' disclosure 
previously provided to you remain unchanged.

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Stearns & Co. 
Inc.'s (-BSC) payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities 
transactions to the primary market for such securities. 
Orders may also be routed to other market service vendors 
that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable 
executions or executions in limit orders at no additional 
charge. 
Beginning October 31, 2001. you may request the identity 
of the venue to which any of your orders were routed for 
execution (if the order was within the six months prior to 
the request cc July 2. 2001. whichever is a later date), 
whether the order was directed by you to that venue, and 
the time of the executions. if any, that resulted from such 
orders.

Securities and other assets in your account are the lint's 
collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities 
and other assets in your account decline in value, so does 
the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and. 85 a 
result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin cal 
and/or see securities or other assets in any of you accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account. It is impoitant that you fully understand the 
risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposited in the 
margin account. 
The fun can force the sale of securities or other assets 
in soar account(s). 
The firm can sell your securities or other assets without 
contacting you, 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or 
other assets in your account(s) are liquidated or sold 
to meet a margin call. 
The firm can increase ifs 'house' maintenance 
requirements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call,

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral 
for any margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in 
your account decline in value. so does the value of the collateral 
supporting you loan, and, as a result, the firm can take action, such 
as issue a margin call and/or sell securities or other assets in any of 
your accounts held with the member. in order to maintain the required 
equity in the account It Is important that you fully understand the 
risks Involved in trading securities on margins These risks include 
the following: 
> You can lose more funds than you deposit In the margin account. 
> The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your 
account(s). 
> The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting 
Tou. 
> You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in 
your account(s) are liquidated or sad to meet a margin call. 
> The firm can increase its 'house maintenance margin requirements 
at any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
> You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margn call.

NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO THE TRUTH IN LENDING 
SEC RULE 10b-16 
Effective as of November 15. 2002, the annual rate of interest charged 
on any Credit extended to you by Bear Stearns Securities for the 
purpose of purchasing. carrying or trading in any security or other 
property shall be based on either the Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate. 
the Bear Stearns Securities Fed Funds Rate or the London Interbank 
Offering Rate (LIBOR')- The Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate will be 
quoted daily by Bear Steams at our main office Xi New York. Factors 
affecting the determination of the Bear Stearns Moran Basis Rate 
will include the short-tam market interest rates quoted by money 
center banks and the Federal Reserve and the rate that Bear Steams 
is charged for borrowing money. The Bear Steams Securities Fed 
Funds Rate is the rate for U.S. dollar funds. as quoted by an 
independent broker of such funds selected by Bear Stearns Securities 
for the last transaction completed prior to 9:30 a.m. (Eastern Time) 
on the business day on which such rate is determined. The annual 
rate of interest will be no more than 3% above the Bear Stearns 
Margin Basis Rate or a% above either the Bear Steams Securities 
Fed Funds Rate or LIBOR and will appear on your monthly statements, 
Since the rate of interest charged is related to the Bear Steams 
Margin Basis Rate. the Bear Steams Securities Fed Funds Rate or 
LIBOR. any changes in these rates will cause corresponding changes 
in the rate charged to your account. which changes will be made 
without pia notice to you. If for any other reason Bear Stearns 
Securities changes the rate of interest it charges you, we will give you 
at least 30 days prior notice. 
The 'Statement of Interest Charges Pursuant to the
Rule 100-16' previously provided to you remains in effect 
except to the extent specifically amended by this notice.

At November 30. 2001 and January 31. 2002. the Companys net 
capital of approximately 42.6 billion and 52.6 billion was 
approximately 9% and 8% of aggregate debit items and exceeded 
the minimum regulatory net capital requirement of approximately 
5604.1 million and 4648.0 million by approximately 42.0 billion and 
$2.0 billion, all respectively. 
A complete copy of the Bear. Steams Securities Corp. Statement 
of Financial Condition is available on the web site

margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in your scrotal 
decline in value. so does the vakie of the collateral supporting your loan, and, 
as a result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin can and/or sell 
securities a other assets in any of your accounts held with the memter, in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks invoked in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the followig: 
' 
You can lose more rinds than you deposit in the margin account. 
• 
The firm can force the sale of securities a other assets In you 
account(s). 
' 
The firm can sell you securities or other assets without contacting you. 
• 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in your 
account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call, 
' 
The firm can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements at 
any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
' 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as fawns: 0 = Outperform; P = Peer Perform; U — Underperforrn. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO = Market Overweight; MW iv Market 
Weight MU iv Market underweight. In cases where the BSC rating is present, the name of an independent, third-party research provider and their rating may also be displayed, 
where such research is available. The various providers use different ratings systems and have Menai/01 them as follows: B 
Buy: H = Hold; S = Sell (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal. or investment advice, Bear Steams is neither soliciting any action based on such information, nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

The research ratings for Bear Stearns (BSC) are shown for certain securities covered by the BSC Equity Research Department. The first rating represents the stock's total return 
relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 - Outperform; P = Peer Perform; U = Underpedonn. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO 4, Market Overweight MW = Market 
Weight; MU = Market inderweight. In cases where the BSC rating is present, the name of an independent. thard•party research provider and their rating may also be displayed. 
where such research is available. The various providers use different ratings systems and have normakzed them as follows: B = Buy; H 
Hold; S - Sell (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal, or investment advice. Bear Steams is neither soficiting any action based on such information. nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent. third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

SPECIAL NOTICE FOR MARGIN CUSTOMERS 
If you are a customer with a margin account. you consent to Bear Steams's 
right to use. lend or pledge any securities held by Bear Steams in your margin 
account. In certain circumstances. such loans or Other use may Emil. in whole 
or in part. your ability to receive dividends directly from the issuing company 
and/or your right to exercise voting and other attendant rights of ownership 
with respect to the loaned. sold or pledged securities. Such circumstances 
include. but are not limited to, loans of securities that you own in your margin 
account that continue over record dates for voting purposes and ox-dividend 
dates for dividend distributions. If you do not receive dividends directly from 
the issuing company. you may receive payments-in-lieu of dividends which 
could cause you to lose the benefit of the preferential tax treatment accorded 
to dividends. 
In an effort to maximize execution quality, Bear Stearns may route your equity 
orders to Its Smart Order Router (SOR). The SOR accepts limit and market 
orders and automates their routing across several sources of liquidity in an 
attempt to maximize price and minimize market impact with respect to your 
order. The SOR routes orders using proprietary algorithms that scan 
exchanges, ECtis and other liquidity venues before it decides a strategy 
designed to achieve an optimal execution for clients. The SOR may in the 
course of executing an instruction change the entered order type from market 
to limit or may change the entered limit price in an attempt to obtain the best 
price. Although the Firm believes that the regular use of this technology 
benefits clients by achieving overall better execution quaky, we cannot 
guarantee an optimal execution on any individual order.

relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 — Outperform; P - Peer Perform; If = Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO 
Market Overweight; MW 
Market 
Weight MU — Market urxlerweight. In cases where the BSC rating is present the name of an independent, third-party research provider and their rating may also be displayed, 
where such research Is available. The various ponders use different ratings systems and have normalized them as follows: B = Buy; H = Hold; S = Sell (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal, or investment advice. Bear Steams is neither soliciting any action based on such Information. nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol Indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

The research ratings for Bear Stearns (BSC) are shown for certain securities covered by the BSC Equity Research Department. The first rating represents the stocks total return 
relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 = Outperform; P xi Peer Perform; U iii Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market Sex. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO 
Market Overweight; lAW ix Market 
Weight; MU - Market underweight. In cases where the BSC rating is present, the name of an independent. third-party research provider and their rating may also be cksplayed, 
where such research is available. The various providers use different ratings systems and have normalized them as follows: B - Buy; H - Hold: S — Set (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal. or investment advice. Bear Steams is neither soliciting any action based on such information, nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not avaIable due to legal reasons. 
Independent, third-party research on certain companies covered by the Firm's research is available to customers of Bear Steams at no cost. Customers can access this research 
at mamee_beatstaaniscom or can call (800) 517-2327 to request that a copy of this research be sent to them.

SPECIAL NOTICE FOR MARGIN CUSTOMERS 
If you are a customer with a margin account, you consent to Bear Steams's 
right to use, lend or pledge any securities held by Bear Steams in your margin 
account, In certain circumstances, such loans or other use may limit, in whole 
or in part, your ability to receive dividends directly from the issuing company 
and/or your right to exercise voting and other attendant rights of ownership 
with respect to the loaned, sold or pledged securities. Such circumstances 
include, but are not limited to, loans of securities that you own in your margin 
account that continue over record dates for voting purposes and ex-dividend 
dates for dividend distributions. If you do not receive dividends directly from 
the issuing company. you may receive payments-in-lieu of dividends which 
could cause you to lose the benefit of the preferential tax treatment accorded 
to dividends. 
NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO TRUTH-IN-LENDING SEC RULE 10b-16 
The purpose of this notice is to advise you of certain changes it the manner in 
which interest will be charged on any U.S. dollar-denominated credit extended 
to you by Bear. Steams Securities Corp. (BSSC') for the purpose of 
pi/chasing, carrying or trading in any security. Interest will continue to be 
based on either the BSSC Margin Basis Rate, or a London Interbank Offered 
Rate ('LIBOR') as specified in the chart below, The BSSC Margin Basis Rate will 
be quoted each business day by BSSC at our main office in New York. Factors 
affecting the detect:laden of the BSSC Margin Basis Rate will include the 
short-term market interest rates quoted by money center banks and the 
Federal Reserve and the rate that BSSC is charged for borrowing money.

relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as fellows: 0 = Outperform; P — Peer Perform; U = Underperfcrm. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market Index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO — Market Overweight kW/ - Market 
Weight MU . Market underweight. In cases where the BSC rating is present. the name of an independent. third-party research provider and their rating may also be displayed. 
where such research Is evadable. The various providers use different ratings systems and have normalized them as tams: 8 - Buy: H — Hold; S 
Sell (this may not atways 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC), The ratings information contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal, or investment advice, Bear Steams is neither soliciting any action based on such information, nor endorsing any recommendation Of opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

represents Me rating er the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO = Market Overweight; MW

where such research is available. The various providers use different ratings systems and have normalized them as follows: B = Buy; H = Hold; S = Sell (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information contained herein is for Informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax, legal, or investment advice. Bear Stearns is neither soliciting any action based on such information, nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons,

Fyre.ce SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Steams Securities Corp. FEtSSC), a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation MIK". provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customer's funds and securities positions. SIPC provides 8500.000 of 
primary net equity protection. Including $100.000 for claims for cash FS1PC 
Coverage). Visit www.sipc.org for more information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection (Excess SIP() through a commercial 
insurer, Effective February 16. 2004. the commercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
wit change to Customer Asset Protection Company CCAPCC). a licensed New 
York insurance company. ACCOUnt protection applies when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC ineligible assets such as options. futures. 
foreign exchange transactions, or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral for any 
marsin loan made to you, If the sectrtties and other assets in your account 
decline in value, so does the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and. 
as a result, the firm can take action, such as Issue a margin call and/or sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member, in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the following: 
- You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
The firm can face the sale of securities or other assets in your account(s). 
• The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting you. 
- You are not entitled to choose ',Nob securities or other assets in your 
account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
- The firm can increase as 'house maintenance margin requirements at any 
time and is not required to provide you advance mitten notice. 
- You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s CBSC-) 
payment for order flow practices.

primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bld or best offer (N880). BSC 
receives no cash payment a other consideration for such order rout hg other 
than favorable executions or executions of tint orders at no additional charge.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Stearns Securities Cap. MSC". a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation (SIPC'), provides account protection fa the net equity 
of a customers funds and securities positions. SIPC provides $500,000 of 
primary net equity protection, including $100,000 for claims fa cash CSIPC 
Coverage". Visit www.sipc.org for more information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection ('Excess SIPC') through a commercial 
insurer. Effective Factory 16, 2004. the commercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer Asset Protection Company CCAPC01, a licensed New 
York insurance company. Account protection applies when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of Investments a to SIPC ineligible assets such as options. futures. 
foreign exchange transactions. or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral for any 
margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in your account 
decline in value, so does the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and. 
as a result, the frm can take action, such as issue a margin cal and/or sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member. in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in you 
account(S). 
The firm can sell you securities or other assets without contacting you. 
• 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in your 
account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
• 
The frm can increase its "house maintenance margin requirements at 
any time and is not required to provide you advance mitten notice. 
• 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

MSS 20.2003 
This statement is provided to explain Bear. Stearns & Co. Inc.'s (MSC) 
payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions to the 
primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer (N860). BSC 
receives no cash payment or other consideration for such ceder routing other 
than favorable executions or executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

for any margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in 
your account decline in value, so does the value of the collateral 
supporting your loan, and, as a result. the firm can take action, such 
as issue a margin call and/or sell securities or other assets in any of 
your accounts held with the member, in order to maintain the required 
equity in the account It Is important that you fully understand the 
risks inyONed in trading Securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
> You can lose mete funds than you deposit in the margin *taunt. 
> The firm can face the sale of securities a other assets In yea 
account(s). 
> The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting 
yOu. 
> You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in 
you account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
> The firm can increase its "house maintenance margin requirements 
at any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
> You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s 
MSC') payment for order flow practices:
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions 
to the primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed 
to other market service vendors that assure executions pursuant to 
complex mathematical formulas at better than the national best bid or 
best offer (NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable executions or 
executions of kink orders at no additional charge.

IMPORTANT NOTICE TO CUENTS: 
Disclosure of Order Execution and Routing Practices 
SEC Rule llaC1-5 (monthly report) requires 'market centers' that 
trade Nasdaq National Market, Nasdaq Small Cap securities and 
exchange-listed Securities to make publicly evadable standardized. 
monthly statistical information about 'catered order' executions, as 
defined by the rule. Friedman, Billings. Ramsey & Co.. Inc. (FEW) 
is an OTC market maker and therefore considered a 'market center. 
Rule1lAc1-5 is intended to promote visibility and competition in 
order execution quality, In order to enable cross-market 
comparisons, the Rule establishes uniform measures of execution 
quality, among them effective spread. rate of price improvement. 
fill rate and execution speed. The rule also requires the statistics 
to be categorized by individual scarily, order type and size 
(100-499 shares. 500-1999, 2000-4999. 5000-9999). It is important 
to note that orders for 10.000 shares or more are exempt from the 
the and are therefore not included in the statistics.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Steams Securities Corp. cEISSC), a member of the qi-owities Investor 
Protection Corporation ('SIPC1. povIdes account protection for the net equity 
of a customer's funds and securities positions. SIPC provides $500.000 of 
pinsy net equity protection. including $100.000 for claims for cash (*SIPC 
Coverage". Visit voitrisipcbcg for more information about SIPC Coverage. 
MSC provides the additional protection ('Excess SIPC through a commercial 
insurer. Effective February 16. 2004. the commercial nsurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer Asset Protection Company rCAPC01. a licensed New 
York insurance company, Account protection applies when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC Iheligible assets such as options. futures. 
foreign exchange transactions, or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities.

Securities and other assets in your account we the firm's collateral for any 
margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in your account 
decline in value. so does the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and. 
as a result. the firm can take action, such as issue a margin call andla sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member, in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in you 
account(s). 
The firm can sell your securities a other assets without contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in your 
accoum(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
The firm can increase its ladose* maintenance margin requirements at 
any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO THE TRUTH IN LENDING SEC 
RULE 10b-16 
Effective as of May 21, 2003. the annual rate of interest charged on 
any credit extended to you by Bear Steams Securities for the purpose of 
purchasing. carrying or trading in any security or other property shall be 
based on either the BSSC Base Lending Rate, the BSSC 
Fed Funds Rate or the London Interbank Offering Rate 
('LIBOR'). The BSSC Base Lending Rate will be quoted by 
Bear Stearns at our main office in New York. Factors affecting the 
determination of the BSSC Base Lending Rate will inckqe the 
short-term market interest rates quoted by money center banks and the 
Federal Reserve and the rate that Bear Steams Securities is charged for 
borrowing money. The BSSC Fed Fund rate is the rate for U.S. 
dollar funds, as quoted by an independent broker or such funds selected 
by Bear Stearns Securities for the last transaction compacted prior to 
9:30 8 .I71. (Eastern Time) on the business day on which such rate is 
determined. The annual rate of interest will be no more than 400 basis 
points above the BSSC Base Lending Rate a 500 basis points 
above either the BSSC Fed Funds Rate of LIBOR and 
will appear on your monthly statements. Since the rate of Interest 
charged is related to the BSSC Base Lending Rate, the BSSC 
Fed Funds Rate a LIBOR. any changes in these rates will 
cause Corresponding changes in the rate charged to your account. which 
changes will be made without prior notice to you. If for any other reason 
Bear Stearns Securities changes the rate of interest it charges you. we 
win give you at least 30 days prior notice. 
The Statement of Interest Charges Pursuant to the Truth.in-Lending 
SEC Rule 100-16 previously provided to you remains in effect except 
to the extent specifically amended by this notice,

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. 
(BSC) payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities 
transactions to the primary market for such securities. 
Orders may also be routed to other market service venders 
that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
fccmulaS at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable 
executions or executions of emit orders at no additional 
charge. 
Bar Beginning October 31. 2001. you may request the identity 
of the venue to which any or your orders were routed for 
execution (if the order was within the six months prior to 
the request or July 2. 2001, whichever is a later date). 
whether the cider was directed by you to that venue, and 
the time of the executions, if any. that resulted from such 
ciders.

for any margin loan made to you, If the securities and other assets in 
your account decline in value, so does the value of the collateral 
supporting your loan, and, as a result, the firm can take action. such 
as issue a margin call and/or sell securities or other assets in any of 
your accounts held with the member, In order to maintain the required 
equity in the account. It is important that you fully understand the 
risks Invoked in tracing securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
> You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
> The Wm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your 
account(s). 
> The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting 
you. 
> You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in 
your acccum(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
> The firm can increase its 'house* maintenance margin requiements

This statement Is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s 
(BSC) payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions 
to the primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed 
to other market service vendors that assure executions ptssuam to 
complex mathematical formulas at better than the national best bid or 
best offer (NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable executions or 
executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO THE TRUTH IN LENDING 
SEC RULE 100-16 
Effective as of November 15, 2002. the annual rate of interest charged 
on any credit extended to you by Bear Steams Secuities (or the 
purpose of purchasing, carrying or trading in any security or other 
property shall be based on either the Bear Steams Margin Basis Rate. 
the Bear Steams Securities Fed Funds Rate or the London Interbank 
Offering Rate ('LIBOR). The Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate will be 
quoted day by Bear Steams at our main office in New York. Factors 
affecting the determination of the Bear Steams Margin Basis Rate 
will include the short-term market interest rates quoted by money 
center banks and the Federal Reserve and the rate that Bear Stearns 
is charged for borrowing money. The Bear Steams Securities Fed 
Funds Rate is the rate for U.S. dollar funds, as quoted by an 
independent broker of such funds selected by Bear Stearns Securities 
for the last transaction completed pia to 9:30 a.m. (Eastern lime) 
on the business day on which such rate is determined. The emu& 
rate of interest will be no more than 3% above the Bear Steams 
Margin Basis Rate or 4% above either the Bear Steams Securities 
Fed Funds Rate or LIBOR and will appear on your monthly statements. 
Since the rate of interest charged is related to the Bear Stearns 
Margin Basis Rate. the Bear Stearns Steadies Fed Funds Rate or 
LIBOR. any changes in these rates will Cause Corresponding changes 
in the rate charged to your account. which changes will be made 
without prior notice to you. If (Or any other reason Bear Steams 
SecuritieS changes the rate of interest it charges you, we will awe you 
at least 30 days prior notice. 
The 'Statement of Interest Charges Pursuant to the Truth-in-Lending" 
SEC Rule 10b-16' previously provided to you remains in effect 
except to the extent specifically amended by this notice.

transactions to the primary market for such securities.

formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(N880). BSC receives no cash payment a other 
consideration for such order routing Other than favorable 
executions or executions of limit orders at no additional 
charge.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's 
collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities 
and other assets in your account decline in value, so does 
the value of the Collateral supporting your loan, and, as a 
result, the frm can take action, such as Issue a margin cal 
and/or sell securities or other assets in any of your accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account It is important that you fuly understand the 
risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposited in the 
margin account. 
The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets 
in your accouM(s). 
The firm can sell your sectrities or other assets without 
contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or 
other assets in your account(s) are liquidated or sod 
to meet a margin call, 
The firm can Increase Ns 'house' maintenance 
requirements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance mitten notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities 
and other assets in your account decline in value. so does

and/or sell securities ar other assets in any of your accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account. It is important that you fully understand the 
risks invaded in trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposited In the 
margin account. 
The limn can force the sale of securities or other assets 
in your account(s). 
The firm can sell your securities or Other assets without 
contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or 
other assets in your account(s) are liquidated or sold 
to meet a margin cat.

requirements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral 
for any margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in 
your account decline in value, so does the value of the collateral 
supporting your loan, and, as a result, the firm can take action, such 
as issue a margin call and/or sell securities or other assets in any of 
your accounts held with the member, in order to maintain the required 
equity in the account. It is important that you fully understand the 
risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
> You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
> The Arm Can force the sale of securities or other assets in your 
account(s). 
> The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting 
You-
> You are not entitled to choose which marines or other assets in 
your account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
> The Arm can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements 
at any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
> You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin cal.

MSC" payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer SeCUritieS transactions 
to the primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed 
to other market service vendors that assure executions pursuant to 
complex mathematical formulas at better than the national best bid or 
best offer (NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable executions or 
executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Steams Scarifies Corp. MSC,. a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation (-sm, provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customers funds and securities positions. SIPC provides 4500,000 of 
primary net equity protection. Including $100,000 for Claims for cash (SIPC 
Coverage'). Visit www.sipc.org for more information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection f Excess SIPC") through a commercial 
insurer, Effective February 16, 2004. the commercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer Asset Protection Company MAPCO", a licensed New 
York insurance company, Account protection applies when a SIPC member

payment for order kw practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions to the 
primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer (NBBO). BSC 
receives no cash payment or other consideration for such order routing other 
than favorable executions or executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

Ine.'S MSC') payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of ciders for customer securities 
transactions to the primary market for such securities. 
Orders may also be routed to other market service vendors 
that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(NB80). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable 
executions or executions of limit orders at no additional 
charge, 
Beginning October 31, 2001, you may request the identity 
of the venue to Much any of your orders were routed for 
execution (if the order was within the six months prior to 
the request or July 2. 2001. whichever is a later date). 
whether the order was directed by you to that venue, and 
the time of the executions, if any, that resulted from such 
orders.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's 
collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities 
and other assets In your account decline in value, so does 
the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and, as a 
result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin cal 
and/or sell securities or other assets In any of your accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account. It is important that you fully understand the 
risks involved in tracing securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposited in the 
margin account. 
The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets 
in you' account(s). 
The firm can set your securities or other assets without 
contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or 
other assets in your account(s) are liquidated or sold 
to meet a margin cal. 
The Trm can increase it's 'house maintenance 
requiements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance mitten notice, 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities 
transactions to the primary market for such securities. 
Orders may also be routed to other market service vendors 
that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable 
executions or executions 015mit orders at no additional 
charge.

of the venue to which any of your orders were routed for 
execution (if the order was within the six months prior to 
the request or July 2, 2001, whichever is 8 later date), 
whether the order was directed by you to that venue, and 
the time of the executions, if any. that resulted from such 
orders.

collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities

the value of the collateral supporting your loan. and. as a 
result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin call 
and/or sell securities or other assets in any of your accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account It is important that you fully understand the 
risks involved In trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
You can lase more funds than you deposited in the 
margin account. 
the firm can force the sale of securities or other assets 
in your account(s). 
The fern can sell your securities or other assets without 
contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or 
other assets in your account(s) are liquidated or sold 
to meet a margin call. 
The firm can increase ifs 'house maintenance 
requirements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margei call.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear, Steams Securities Corp. (BSSC), a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation CSIPC). provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customers funds and securities positions. SIPC provides $500,000 of 
primary net equity protection, including $100,000 for claims for cash CSIPC 
Coverage,. Visit www.SipC.Org for more information about SIPC Coverage, 
BSSC provides the additional protection (' Excess SIPC) through a commercial 
insurer. Effective February 16, 2004. the commercial Insurer for Excess SIPC 
will change to Customer Asset Protection Company MAPCO". a licensed New 
York insurance company. Account protection applies when a SIPC member 
rrm fails financially and is unable to meet its obigations to Its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC ineligible assets such as options. futures. 
foreign exchange transactions, or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities.

are reminded of the risks inherent in attempting to maintain or 
increase the average yield on a fired income portfolio. Generally, 
securities carrying a higher yield come with some combination of 
added credit risk. extended maturities, reduced liquidity. or special 
call features. Rising interest rates can cause a decline in the 
market value of your portfolio. which will impact your principal if 
securities are sold prior to maturity. Please consult your Bear Steams 
account executive if you would like to discuss your fixed income 
portfolio. Asa leader in Fixed Income, Bear Stearns can analyze 
any portfolio. held here or elsewhere and make recommendations 
Such that you' portfolio is aligned within your tolerance for risk,

margin loan made to you. If the sectrities and Other assets in your account 
destine in value. so does the value of the collateral supporting you loan, and, 
as a result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin call andlor sell 
securities or other assets in any of your' accounts held with the member. in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the foaming: 
• You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
• The frm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your account(s), 
• The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting you. 
• You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in your 
accounts) are %quidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
• The frm can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements at any 
time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
• You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin cal.

Notice Regarding a Change In The Statement of Interest Charges 
Pursuant to the "Trutlein-Lending" Rule 10 (0)-16 Regarding Short Sales 
And MILEM11940.ThOMEEEM 
Effective no earlier than thirty (30) days from your receipt of this statement. we 
will compute interest regarding your short sales and marking-to-the market as 
follows: 
The credit that appears on your statement due to short sales (including short 
sales against the box) is offset by a debit of like amount because Bear Stearns 
Securities has to borrow the same security in order to deliver it to the buying 
broker and has to provide its lender additional collateral of up to 105%d the 
settled short market value of the borrowed securities to secure such loan. This 
means that the debit balance on which interest is computed will be the 
difference between (0 up to 105% of the settled short market value of such 
short sales (across all currencies). which shall be calculated daily. and (ii) the 
proceeds of such short sales. 
VS' Any short positions in your account will be kept 'marked-to-the marker. This 
means that periodically the balance maintained in the short account will be 
adjusted to equal the market value of the short securities. Securities that are 
priced below the dollars per share may be valued at five dollars per share for 
start marking-to-the market purposes. If a security has been sold short (or 
sold short against the box) and has appreciated in market price over the 
selling price. interest will be charged on the amount of appreciation; if it 
depreciates in market price, interest will be correspondingly reduced by the 
drop in value. The appreciation or depreciation of securities sold short will be 
determined by Bear Steams Securities based upon daily closing prices or 
quotations provided by pricing services. as applicable, or upon such factors as 
Bear Stearns Securities in its sole judgement deems pertinent. 
Please note that the other sections of the "Truth-in-Lending' disclosure 
previously provided to you remain unchanged.

Securities and other assets In your account are the firm's collateral for any 
margin loan made to you, If the securities and other assets in your account 
decine in value, so does the value of the collateral supporting your ban, and, 
as a result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin call andlor sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member. in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It Is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These asks 
include the following: 
- You can lose more &ids than you deposit in the margin account. 
- The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your account(s). 
- The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting you. 
- You are not entitled to choose which Securities or other assets in your 
account(s) are liquidated a sold to meet a margin call, 
- The firm can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements at any 
time and is not required to provide you advance mitten notice. 
• You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin cal,

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s CBSC1 
payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions to the 
primary market (or such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer (NBBO). BSC 
receives no cash payment or other consideration for such order railing other 
than favorable executions or executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

SPECIAL NOTICE FOR MARGIN CUSTOMERS 
If you are a customer with a margin account, you consent to Bear Steams's 
right to use. lend or pledge any securities held by Bear Stearns in your margin 
account. In certain circumstances, such loans or other use may limit. in whole 
or in part. your ability to receive dividends directly from the issuing company 
and/or your right to exercise voting and other attendant rights of ownership 
with respect to the loaned, sold or pledged securities. Such circumstances 
include, but are not limited to. loans of securities that you own in you margin 
account that continue over record dates for voting purposes and ex.dividend 
dates for dividend distributions. If you do not receive dividends directly from 
the issuing company. you may receive payments-in-lieu of dividends which 
could cause you to lose the benefit of the preferential tax treatment accorded 
to dividends. 
In an effort to maximize execution quality. Boar Stearns may route your equity 
orders to its Smart Order Router (SOR). The SOR accepts limit and market 
orders and automates their routing across several sources of liquidity in an 
attempt to maximize price and minimize market impact vrith respect to your 
order. The SOR routes orders using proprietary algorithms that scan 
exchanges. ECN's and other liquidity venues before it decides a strategy 
designed to achieve an optimal execution for orients. The SOR may in the 
come of executing an ingiudion change the entered order type from market 
to limit or may change the entered brit price in an attempt to obtain the best 
price. Although the Firm believes that the regular use of this technology 
benefits clients by achieving overall better execution quality. we cannot 
guarantee an optimal execution on any individual order.

SPECIAL NOTICE FOR MARGIN CUSTOMERS 
If you are a customer with a margin account, you consent to Bear Steams's 
right to use. lend or pledge any scarifies held by Bear Stearns in your margin 
account. In certain circumstances. such loans or other use may limit, in whole 
or in part, your ability to receive dividends directly from the issuing company 
and/or your right to exercise voting and other attendant rights of ownership 
with respect to the loaned, sold or pledged securities, Such circumstances 
include, but are not limited to. loans of securities that you own in your margin 
account that continue over record dates for voting purposes and ex-dividend 
dates for dMdend diuntutions. If you do not receive dividends directly from 
the issuing company, you may receive payments-in-lieu of deridends which 
could cause you to lose the benefit of the preferential tax treatment accorded 
to dividends.

formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer 
(NBBO). BSC receives no cash payment a other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable 
executions or executions of unit orders at no additional 
charge. 
Beginning October 31, 2001, you may request the identity 
of the vemie to which any of your orders were routed for 
execution (if the order was within the six months eta to 
the request or July 2. 2001, whichever is a later date), 
whether the Order was directed by you to that venue, and 
the time of the e:cecutions, if any, that resulted from such 
ciders.

Securities and other assets in you account are the firm's 
collateral for any margin loan made to you. If the securities 
and other assets in your account decline in value. so does 
the value of the collateral supporting your loan. and, as a 
result, the firm can take action, such as issue a margin call 
and/or sell securities or other assets in any of your accounts 
held with the member, in order to maintain the required equity 
in the account. It is important that you tufty understand the 
risks invoked in trading securities on margin, These risks include 
the following: 
You can lose more funds than you deposited in the 
margin account. 
The firm can face the sale of securities or oche assets 
in your account(s). 
The firm can sell your securities or other assets without 
contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities a 
other assets in yea account(s) are liquidated or sold 
to meet a margin can. 
The firm can increase it's 'house maintenance 
requirements at any time and is not required to provide 
you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral 
for any margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in 
you' account decline in value, so does the value of the collateral 
supporting your loan, and, as a result, the firm can take action, such 
as issue a margin call and/or sell securities or other assets in any of 
your accounts held with the member, in order to maintain the required 
equity in the account. It is important that you fully understand the 
risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks include 
the following: 
> You can lose more finCIS than you deposit in the margin account. 
> The firm can farce the sale of securities or other assets in your 
account(s). 
> The firm can sel your securities or other assets without contacting 
you. 
> You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in 
your account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
> The firm can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements 
at any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
> You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. InC.'S 
(*BSC) payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions 
to the primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed 
to other market service vendors that assure executions pursuant to 
complex mathematical formulas at better than the national best bid or 
best offer (N880). BSC receives no cash payment or other 
consideration for such order routing other than favorable executions or 
executions of limit orders at no additional charge.

NOTICE OF CHANGE PURSUANT TO THE TRUTH IN LENDING 
SEC RULE 100-16 
Effective as of November 15. 2002. the annual rate of interest charged 
on any credit extended to you by Bear Steams Sectrities for the 
purpose of purchasing. carrying or trading in any security or other 
property shall be based on either the Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate. 
the Bear Stearns Securities Fed Funds Rate a the London Interbank 
Offering Rate ('LIBORD. The Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate Me be 
quoted daffy by Bear Stearns at ax main office in New York, Factors 
affecting the determination of the Bear Stearns Margin Basis Rate 
MI include the short-term market interest rates quoted by money 
center banks and the Federal Reserve and the rate that Bear Steams 
Is charged for borrowing money. The Bear Steams Securities Fed 
Funds Rate is the rate for U.S. dollar funds, as quoted by an 
independent broker of such funds selected by Bear Stearns Securities 
for the last transaction completed prior to 9:30 a.m. (Eastern Time) 
on the business day on which such rate is determined. The annual 
rate of Interest will be no more than 3% above the Bear Stearns 
Margin Basis Rate or 4% above either the Bear Steams Secunues 
Fed Funds Rate or LIBOR and will appear on your monthly statements. 
Since the rate of interest charged is related to the Bear Steams 
Margin Basis Rate. the Bear Stearns Securities Fed Funds Rate or 
LIBOR. any changes in these rates will cause corresponding changes 
in the rate charged to your account. which changes will be made 
without prior notice to you. If for any other reason Bear Stearns 
Securities changes the rate of interest it charges you. we will give you 
at least 30 days prior notice. 
The 'Statement of Interest Charges Pursuant to the 'Truth-Intending' 
SEC Rule 10b-16" previously provided to you remains in effect 
except to the extent specifically amended by this notice.

Excess SIPC Account Protection Update 
Bear. Stearns Securities Corp. (BSSC). a member of the Securities Investor 
Protection Corporation CSIPC). provides account protection for the net equity 
of a customers funds and securities positions. SIPC provides 5500.000 of 
primary net equity protection. including 5100,000 for claims for cash CSIPC 
Coverage'). Visit vainv.sipc.org for more information about SIPC Coverage. 
BSSC provides the additional protection (trans SIPC') through a commercial 
insure(. Effective February 16, 2004, the commercial insurer for Excess SIPC 
vAll change to Customer Asset Protection Company CCAPC01. a licensed New 
York insurance company. Account protection applies when a SIPC member 
firm fails financially and is unable to meet its obligations to its securities 
customers, but does not apply to losses from the rise or fall in the market 
value of investments or to SIPC 'ineligible assets such as options. futures. 
foreign exchange transactions. or any investment contracts that are not 
registered as securities,

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's collateral for any 
margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in your account 
decline in value. so does the value of the collateral supporting your loan. and. 
as a result, the firm can take action. such as issue a margin call and/or sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member. in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is Important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the folowing: 
You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in you 
account(s). 
The firm can sell your seCurities or other assets without contacting you. 
You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in yoke 
account(s) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin call. 
The firm can Increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements at 
any time and is not required to provide you advance written notice. 
You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

This statement is provided to explain Bear. Steams & Co. Inc.'s rEiSC1 
payment for order flow practices. 
BSC routes a majority of orders for customer securities transactions to the 
primary market for such securities. Orders may also be routed to other market 
service vendors that assure executions pursuant to complex mathematical 
formulas at better than the national best bid or best offer (N880). BSC 
receives no cash payment or other consideration fa such order routing other 
than favorable executions or executions of limit orders at no adcktional charge.

portfolio. As a leader in Fixed Income. Bear Stearns can analyze 
any portfolio. held here or elsewhere and make recommendations

The research ratings for Bear Stearns (BSC) are Shown for certain securities covered by the Firm's Equity Research Department. The first rating represents the stock's total tarn 
relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 — Outperform: P — Peer Perform: U = Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO ••• Market Overweight: MW 
Market 
Weight: MU = Market Underweight. In cases where a BSC rating is present. the name of an Independent. third-parry research provider and their rating may also be displayed. 
where such research is available. The various providers have normalized their ratings systems as follows: B - Buy: H - Hold: $ — Sell. The ratings information contained herein 
is for informational purposes only and is not intended to provide tax. legal or investment advice. Bear Stearns is neither soliciting any action based on such information. nor 
endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by any independent. third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage or the subject 
company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons. 
Independent. third-party research on certain companies covered by the Firm's research Is evadable to customers of Bear Stearns at no cost. Customers can access this research 
at w.w.bearsteann.com or can cal (800) 517.2327 to request that a copy of this research be sent to them.

margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in you account

securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member. in 
order to maintain the required equity in the attain. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the folowing: 
• You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
• The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your account(s). 
• The firm can sell you securities or other assets without contacting you. 
• You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in you 
account(S) are liquidated or sold to meet a margin cal. 
• the lint can increase its 'house' maintenance margin requirements at any

follows:

sales against the box) is offset by a debit of like amouM because Bear Stearns 
Securities has to borrow the same security in order to deliver it to the buying 
Peter and has to provide its lender additional collateral of up to 105% of the 
settled short market value of the borrowed securities to score such ban• This 
means that the debit balance on which Interest Is computed will be the 
difference between () up to 105% of the settled short market value of such 
short sales (across all currencies), wtrich shall be calculated daily. and (b) the 
proceeds of such short sales.

The research ratings for Bear Steams (BSC) are shown for certain secaities covered by the Frm's Equity Research Department. The first rating represents the stock's total 
return relative to the other stocks covered by that AntilySt. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 - Outperform: P - Peer Perform: U 
Underperform. The second 
rating represents the rating of the coverage unnerse relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO — Market Overweight: MW 
Market Weight: MU = Market Underweight. In cases where a BSC rating is present, the name of an independent, third-party research praricler and their rating may also be 
displayed. where such research is available. The various providers have normalized their ratings systems as follows: B = Buy: H = Hold: S — Sell. The ratings information 
contained herein is for informational purposes only and is not intended to provide tax, legal or investment advice. Bear Steams is neither sobering any action based on such 
information. nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by any independent. third-party research provider. The symbol Indicates that continuing coverage of 
the subject company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

relative to the Other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as lotions: 0 - Outperform; P = Peer Perform; U 
Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage uneerse relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the Sector rating is as foibles: MO - Market Overweight: MW is Market 
Weight: MU = Market Underweight. In cases where a BSC rating is present. the name of an independent third-party research provider and their rating may also be displayed. 
where such research is available. The various providers have normalized their ratings systems as follows: B — Buy: H - Hold; S - Sell. The ratings information contained herein

Securities and other assets in your account are the firm's C011ateral for any 
margin loan made to you. If the securities and other assets in your account 
decline in value. so does the value of the collateral supporting your loan, and, 
as a result, the firm can take action, such as Issue a margin call and/or sell 
securities or other assets in any of your accounts held with the member, in 
order to maintain the required equity in the account. It is important that you 
fully understand the risks involved in trading securities on margin. These risks 
include the following: 
- You can lose more funds than you deposit in the margin account. 
- The firm can force the sale of securities or other assets in your account(s). 
- The firm can sell your securities or other assets without contacting you. 
• You are not entitled to choose which securities or other assets in your 
account(s) are liquidated or sob to meet a margin can, 
- The firm can increase its "house" maintenance margin requirements at any 
time and is not required to provide you atiVenCe written notice, 
- You are not entitled to an extension of time on a margin call.

The research ratings for Bear Stearns (BSC) are shown for certain securities covered by the Firm's Equity Research Department. The first rating represents the stork's total return 
relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 - Outperform; P - Peer Perform: U = Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO - Market Overweight MW - Market 
Weight MU = Market Underweight. In cases where a BSC rating is present, the name of an independent, thid•party research provider and their rating may also be displayed, 
where such research is evadable. The various providers have normalized their ratings systems as follows: B - Buy; H - Hold: S - Sell. The ratings information contained herein 
is for informational purposes only and Is not intended to provide tax, legal cr investment advice. Bear Stearns is neither soliciting any action based on such information. nor 
endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject 
company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons. 
Independent. thkl-party research on certain concompanies covered by the Firm's research is available to customers of Bear Stearns at no cost. Customers can access this research

represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the setter rating is as follows: MO 
Market Overweight MW - Market 
Weight MU = Market Underweight. In cases where a BSC rating is present. the name of an independent, third-party research provider and their rating may also be displayed, 
where such research is available. The various providers have normalized thee ratings systems as follows: 8 — Buy: H — Hold: S - Sell. The ratings information contained herein 
is for informational purposes only and is not intended to provide tax, legal or investment advice, Bear Stearns is neither soliciting any action based on such information, nor 
endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject 
company is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.

relative to the other stocks covered by that Analyst. The key for the stock rating values is as follows: 0 = Outperform: P - Peer Perform; U — Underperform. The second rating 
represents the rating of the coverage universe relative to the regional broader market index. The key for the sector rating is as follows: MO = Market Overweight: MW = Market 
Weight: MU — Mantel underweight. In cases *here the BSC rating is present, the name of an independent, third-party research pronder and their rating may also be displayed, 
where such research is available. The various providers use different ratings systems and have normalized them as follows: B = Buy: H = Hold: S = Sell (this may not always 
correspond directly to the underlying rating system used by each provider or BSC). The ratings information Contained herein Is for informational purposes only and is not intended 
to provide tax. legal. or investment advice. Bear Steams is neither soliciting any action based on such information. nor endorsing any recommendation or opinion expressed by 
any independent, third-party research provider. The symbol indicates that continuing coverage of the subject company Is temporarily not available due to legal reasons.
